note: ⛔ SNG-464. Two Mind strikes — a direct psychic attack and a thought-guided physical one. Erik: 'great psychic strikes, as well as using the mind like Sherlock Holmes for physical attacks with incredible accuracy and effect.'

abilities.name: Deduced Strike
abilities.narrationHints: They watch for one exchange without engaging, and then hit once — the buckle, the old break, the foot that carries the weight — and a much better fighter is suddenly on the ground wondering how.
abilities.description: Read a foe mid-fight without breaking stride, and land an ordinary blow exactly where it does the most — thought aimed through a body, and it hits like a much stronger arm.
abilities.notFor: An enemy you have not read; anything you cannot physically reach; a contest that ends before you get a second round.

intensity.conserve: a partial read — half the aim, and an ordinary blow
intensity.surge: strike everything you read; THE READING COSTS YOU THE ROUND

crit.success: You read the fight and the blow in one motion, and it lands before they have finished starting.
crit.failure: You read a pattern they were about to abandon.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU MUST HAVE WATCHED THEM — one full exchange, or a known pattern from before
⚠️ IT IS AN ORDINARY BLOW, PLACED PERFECTLY — you still need a weapon or a hand and you still must reach
a foe who changes their pattern resets what you knew
the watching exchange is one you spent not attacking

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action that deals damage. It rolls 2d6. Ranks: rank 2 lets you call the effect, rank 3 reads and strikes in the same round.

sectFlavour.cogitant: YOU MODELLED THEM — their reach, their favoured side, the joint that has been hurt before.
sectFlavour.syllogist: YOU REASONED IT — a fighter who does that must also do this, and this is where it leaves them open.
sectFlavour.figurist: YOU READ THEIR FORM — every stance is an instance of a shape, and shapes have gaps.

tree.name: Read the Fight
tree.grants: ⛔ RESOLVES IN THE SENSE SLOT — IT DOES NOT COST YOU YOUR ACTION. Read a foe mid-fight and mark where they are weakest: an old injury, a badly-set strap, the foot carrying the weight. ⚠️ THEN STRIKE WITH IT IN THE SAME ROUND — the mark is worth a large edge on your next blow, and it banks tempo.
tree.cannot: One foe at a time, and the mark is spent when you use it. A foe who changes what they are doing clears it.

tree.name: Called Effect
tree.grants: ⛔ DEALS 2d6 DAMAGE AND A DECLARED OUTCOME. Name what the blow does as well as that it lands — the shield arm drops, the weapon goes, the knee gives, they cannot pursue.
tree.cannot: One declared effect, and it must be physically plausible from where you hit.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS A DECLARED OUTCOME. Name what the blow does as well as that it lands — the shield arm drops, the weapon goes, the knee gives, they cannot pursue. ⛔ It happens because you aimed at the thing that causes it.

tree.name: Strike in the Reading
tree.grants: ⛔ THE BLOW LANDS IN THE SENSE SLOT ITSELF. You do not read and then strike — the reading IS the strike, resolved before the round's actions are declared, and your action slot is still untouched. ⚠️ TWO ATTACKS IN A ROUND, AND THE FIRST ONE ARRIVES BEFORE ANYONE HAS MOVED.
tree.cannot: ⚠️ Once per round, and against one foe — the second blow is still an ordinary action. A foe you have never seen fight gives you less to aim at.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-464. Erik: 'a Mind character should be able to use the mind (LIKE SHERLOCK HOLMES) to perform PHYSICAL ATTACKS with incredible accuracy and effect — a combo ability powered by thought.' ⚠️ `nativeOrCombination: combination` — this is thought aimed through a body, and the sect flavours differ in HOW the answer is reached.
abilities._systemFit:
⛔ SNG-466, RE-AUTHORED. Erik: 'I don't know how it will work to CONCEDE THE MOMENTUM that round. Better to make sure it's TAGGED WITH READ at r1 so it can be used in the SENSE ROUND of a fight then used AGAIN in the action round.'
⚠️ HE IS RIGHT AND MY VERSION WAS WORSE IN FEEL AS WELL AS HARDER TO WIRE — a fighter reading their opponent is not standing still. ⛔ r1 NOW RESOLVES IN THE SENSE SLOT and does not spend the action, so the same round contains the read AND the strike. See content/packs/core/rules/tempo.json.
abilities._rangeNote: ⚠️ Erik: 'I don't think we have a measured range to utilise — keep that part defined in the prose for now.' `range` removed from mechanic; reach is described in the text.
abilities._r3: ⛔ SNG-467. Erik: 'I really like the r3 ability to EXECUTE THE ATTACK IN THE READ STEP — that is super powerful.' ⚠️ It is, and that is correct for a level-2 tradition capstone rank: the blow resolves before the round's actions are declared, and the action slot stays free. TWO ATTACKS, THE FIRST ONE PRE-EMPTIVE.
abilities._senseNote: ⛔ SNG-469: usable in the sense slot as a SENSE. Reads the opponent, banks tempo, takes the craft's edge.
abilities._typed_20260829: ⛔ COMPOSITE — 'THOUGHT AIMED THROUGH A BODY'. The blow is ORDINARY (`physical` .7); what makes it land where it does is the read (`psychic` .3). ⚠️ ITS `notFor` FORCES THE MIX: 'an enemy you have not read' AND 'anything you cannot physically reach' — it needs BOTH, so it deals both. ⛔ Armour answers most of it; a mind that cannot be read answers the rest, and neither alone stops it.
abilities._intensityAuthored_20260829: ⚠️ WAS THE BARE STRING 'moderate' — a HARM WORD in the intensity field, from an older schema where `intensity` meant severity. ⛔ The engine reads a conserve/surge PAIR (`engine/intensity.js`), so a string meant this craft had NO conserve and NO surge and silently resolved at standard only. Authored as a real pair: conserve gives up scope for cost, surge takes something from the wielder.

abilities.name: Psychic Lance
abilities.narrationHints: Nothing crosses the space between them. The target's head goes back as though struck, and there is no mark, and they are bleeding from the nose.
abilities.description: Drive a spike of focused thought straight into a mind at range — no vector, no contact, nothing to block, and it hurts exactly as much as being hit.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ TARGETS OUT OF SIGHT — you must be able to see what you are driving it into. ⚠️ AND IT WOUNDS THE THINKING, NOT THE BODY: it will not open a door, break a bone, or move anything. ⛔ AGAINST A THING WITH NO MIND IT STILL ARRIVES — there is nothing to interpose and the force is real — but there is less for it to find, and such things RESIST it rather than being opened by it.

intensity.conserve: a touch of it — they feel wrong and do not know why
intensity.surge: all of it at once; ⛔ A MIND THAT TAKES THE WHOLE LANCE DOES NOT GET UP

crit.success: The bolt splits on the way and takes a second mind you had not chosen.

failure.text: It reaches, finds nothing to hurt, and comes back down the same line into you.

mechanic._noRequiresSelf_20260830: ⛔ `requiresSelf` REMOVED. ERIK 2026-08-30: 'check psychic lance — it seems like that one MIGHT STILL HAVE SOME IMPACT even if the thing doesn't have a mind.' ⚠️ HE IS RIGHT AND I WAS DEFENDING AUTHORED PROSE RATHER THAN QUESTIONING IT: the craft's own notFor said 'anything without a mind', and I declared the field to match the sentence instead of testing the sentence. ✅ BY ERIK'S OWN GRIEF-STRIKE RULE THE THOUGHT IS GENERATED BY A MIND THAT HAS ONE, and it is delivered with 'no vector, no contact, NOTHING TO BLOCK' — it arrives at a construct as surely as anywhere. ⛔ AND r3 PROVES IT: 'the struck mind CANNOT HOLD ANYTHING for a round — a sustained craft drops, a held action is lost.' A feral construct running a broken directive has something it is holding. ⚠️ SOME IMPACT, NOT FULL — AND THAT IS `resist` ON THE CREATURE, NOT A BLOCK ON THE CRAFT. A binary craft-level bar cannot express 'less', which is what Erik asked for; the affinity verdict can.

bounds.text: ⛔ NOTHING BLOCKS IT — no armour, no cover, no shield. It does not travel
⚠️ IT NEEDS A MIND. A construct, a corpse or a mechanism takes nothing
you must be able to see them, and they will know instantly who did it
⚠️ a mind that strikes back reaches you the same way — this is a duel neither party can hide from

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action that deals damage. It rolls 3d6. Ranks: rank 2 strikes two minds, rank 3 leaves the target unable to hold anything.

tree.name: Driven Spike
tree.grants: ⛔ DRIVE ONE SPIKE OF THOUGHT INTO A MIND IN SIGHT. Armour, cover and shields are irrelevant — nothing crosses the space, so nothing can be interposed.
tree.cannot: One mind, in sight. It needs a mind to hurt.

tree.name: Two at Once
tree.grants: ⛔ DEALS 3d6 DAMAGE SPLIT ACROSS TWO MINDS IN SIGHT without losing weight on either — or put both into one, for a great deal more. Nothing can be interposed.
tree.cannot: Two at most, and both must be in sight when you begin.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS TARGETS. Split the strike across two minds in sight without losing weight on either — or put both into one, for a great deal more.

tree.name: Nothing Held
tree.grants: ⛔ DEALS 3d6 DAMAGE AND THE STRUCK MIND CANNOT HOLD ANYTHING FOR A ROUND — a sustained craft drops, a held action is lost, a spoken command comes out wrong.
tree.cannot: One round, and a mind holding nothing loses nothing.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS AFTERMATH. The struck mind cannot hold anything for a round — a sustained craft drops, a held action is lost, a spoken command comes out wrong. ⚠️ Against a caster this is worse than the wound.
tree._imposes: ⛔ SNG-513. ⛔ The struck mind cannot hold anything for a round — a sustained craft drops.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-464. Erik: 'a Mind character should have some GREAT PSYCHIC STRIKES.' ⚠️ Mind's existing damage was Cutting Figure (1d6, figurist geometry) and Sustained Regard (1d6, attention). ⛔ NEITHER WAS A DIRECT PSYCHIC ATTACK — this is the tradition's straight ranged hit, and its defining property is that NOTHING CAN BE INTERPOSED.
abilities._rangeNote: ⚠️ SNG-465: measured `range` removed per Erik — reach stays in the prose ('any mind in sight').
abilities._typed_20260829: ⛔ PURE `psychic` — INTRINSIC family, mental end. The craft's own words: 'no vector, no contact, NOTHING TO BLOCK'. ⚠️ THAT IS THE FAMILY'S DEFINING PROPERTY MADE LITERAL — intrinsic harm requires a WILL to make it and a self to receive it, and its `notFor` says both halves: 'anything without a mind' and 'hurting a body directly'. ⛔ ARMOUR IS NO ANSWER AND THAT IS CORRECT; what answers it is a mind-ward or being unreachable.
abilities._intensityAuthored_20260829: ⚠️ WAS THE BARE STRING 'severe' — a HARM WORD in the intensity field, from an older schema where `intensity` meant severity. ⛔ The engine reads a conserve/surge PAIR (`engine/intensity.js`), so a string meant this craft had NO conserve and NO surge and silently resolved at standard only. Authored as a real pair: conserve gives up scope for cost, surge takes something from the wielder.
abilities._surgeFix_20260829: ⛔ THE SURGE WAS 'YOU WILL FEEL WHAT YOU DID TO THEM' — a penalty for using your own craft. ⚠️ Erik 2026-08-29: 'STOP THE NEGATIVE ASPECTS OF HEROIC SKILLS.' A surge should say what going all-out ACHIEVES.
abilities._theHabit_20260830: ⚠️ RANK NAMES STRIPPED OF THE LEADING ARTICLE. ⛔ ERIK HAS CORRECTED MY 'The' HABIT TWICE, and both times I checked CRAFT NAMES ONLY — fourteen RANK names were still carrying it. ✅ The self-check was measuring the wrong field, which is why the habit survived being caught. ⚠️ `reaping_sickle` r3 also collided with `the_known_name` r2 — both were 'The Whole Field'.

_gainAxes: ⛔ SNG-468: `gainAxes` derived per rank from the rank's own text. ⚠️ MY MATRIX HAD BEEN READING UNPOPULATED RANKS AS 'ADDS NOTHING' — Erik caught it on Borrowed Form, whose ranks are an hour / a day plus a passenger / the whole party. THE SKILL WAS FINE; THE INSTRUMENT WAS BROKEN.
_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng513: ⛔ SNG-513: `imposes` and `ongoingHarm` authored. Both readers were live and unfed — CCode named the fields rather than authoring content. ⚠️ `onCrit` IS ESCALATE: a crit imposes a DIFFERENT, stronger condition. `slain` is refused at all three doors — a craft is not a situation.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
